'''Alie''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Private/Legends|private]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3640 BBY]] she was stationed on a Republic [[Space station/Legends|space station]] above [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] selling gear components.
